usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.images.edits.create(images=[None], prompt="string", model="string", mask=None, n=1, quality="low", input_fidelity="high", size="auto", user="string", output_format="png", output_compression=1, moderation="low", background="transparent", stream=False, partial_images=1)
print(result)
